label.explanation: search-api v2.8.0 rolled out shortly before onset (lines 152, 160). Right after, search-api started throwing a TypeError in the new formatter code, tagged with v2.8.0 (lines 172, 187, 198, 213). Only requests that hit that path fail, so most traffic still succeeds and the web-bff 500s are partial (lines 175, 189, 199, 212, 222, 234, 247, 255, 266, 274, 285, 298). It looks like bad input data, but the field is missing for any product without 'locale' — a code regression. Roll back to v2.7.8. Red herrings: line 157 (a config reload that changed nothing); line 73 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out); line 169 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400).
